treatment_records.name: prednisone
treatment_records.reason_stopped: made him rage, had to get off

evidence_notes: Diagnosed with Crohn's two years ago, likely had it longer due to pushing through symptoms common in his construction work. Initial treatments (mesalamine, prednisone) were ineffective or caused significant side effects (rage). Biologics were recommended but are facing insurance coverage issues ('fail first' policy) and cost barriers. Patient is struggling with the physical demands of his job, weight loss, and financial strain, impacting work and self-esteem. He is hesitant about biologics due to cost and perceived immune suppression risks but acknowledges the need for better symptom control.
